projection.instruction: Read `simulation_results` and `execution_results`. Return `post_execution_diagnostic` as an object decorating the existing simulated checklist without regenerating its items. `checklist` retains the same entries in the same order. Each `condition_id`, `expected`, and `simulated` preserves the original value, and `passed` preserves the simulation's Boolean prediction. `actual` describes the observed condition. `status` is exactly `pass`, `fail`, or `unverified`. `discrepancy` describes differences between expected and actual results, or is empty if none exists; it supersedes the earlier predicted discrepancy. `evidence` is an array of supporting observations or verification results. `overall_result` is `pass` only when every item passes, `fail` when a verified discrepancy exists, or `incomplete` when verification remains unresolved without an established failure.

question_answers.question: What research phase is next according to the existing status ledger?
question_answers.answer: The current ledger prescribes CVD-P1A-01 for the first historical candidate-discovery batch, followed by P1A-02. Add a parallel APG branch to honor new scope.

question_answers.question: What historical interval and discovery batch limit govern P1A-01?
question_answers.answer: Years 1858 through 1949; up to 20 new independent screened source records, separate from the 15 seed records, and maximum 40 materially opened web resources.

question_answers.question: Should APG devices be included even without persistent mean swirl?
question_answers.answer: Yes. APG-induced separation, reattachment, wall jet attachment, recirculation and feedback are relevant contrasts, including when net angular momentum is negligible.

question_answers.question: How must fluidic oscillators be categorized by feedback and flow topology?
question_answers.answer: Separate external feedback channels, feedback-free chamber self-oscillation, jet-driven Helmholtz modes, captive-vortex spin-up delays and steady separated flow. Do not deduce APG presence or vortex breakdown from the device label.

question_answers.question: Which attached source documents are available for the oscillator branch?
question_answers.answer: User-provided cfd_oscillators_refset.zip contains Tesar 2012 microbubble oscillator, 2015 gas reversal, 2017 taxonomic trees, 2019 time delay circuits, 2019 captive vortex spin-up, 2021 Helmholtz experimental study, US4041984 and US4347983. Title-page text inspected.

question_answers.question: How should primary papers, patent families and vendor claims be distinguished?
question_answers.answer: Use T theory, E experiment, R review, H reports, P patent families, C vendor context; keep source identity and full-text status independent from technical assertions; group patent family by priority.

question_answers.question: What level of experimental claims can be made from abstracts or PDF title pages?
question_answers.answer: Abstracts and title pages establish bibliographic identity and reported purpose, not measured pressure gradient, operating envelope, threshold, mechanism verification or claimed performance. Mark those unknown until full-text processing.

question_answers.question: Should APG devices be included even without persistent mean swirl?
question_answers.answer: Yes. APG-induced separation, reattachment, wall jet attachment, recirculation and feedback are relevant contrasts, including when net angular momentum is negligible.

question_answers.question: How must fluidic oscillators be categorized by feedback and flow topology?
question_answers.answer: Separate external feedback channels, feedback-free chamber self-oscillation, jet-driven Helmholtz modes, captive-vortex spin-up delays and steady separated flow. Do not deduce APG presence or vortex breakdown from the device label.

question_answers.question: Which attached source documents are available for the oscillator branch?
question_answers.answer: User-provided cfd_oscillators_refset.zip contains Tesar 2012 microbubble oscillator, 2015 gas reversal, 2017 taxonomic trees, 2019 time delay circuits, 2019 captive vortex spin-up, 2021 Helmholtz experimental study, US4041984 and US4347983. Title-page text inspected.

question_answers.question: How should primary papers, patent families and vendor claims be distinguished?
question_answers.answer: Use T theory, E experiment, R review, H reports, P patent families, C vendor context; keep source identity and full-text status independent from technical assertions; group patent family by priority.

question_answers.question: What level of experimental claims can be made from abstracts or PDF title pages?
question_answers.answer: Abstracts and title pages establish bibliographic identity and reported purpose, not measured pressure gradient, operating envelope, threshold, mechanism verification or claimed performance. Mark those unknown until full-text processing.

question_answers.answer: A batch findings Markdown, extended Source_Catalog.csv, a mechanism addendum to master and new Research_Status_and_Next_Batch.md version in workspaces/confined-vortex-dynamics-research, committed and readback verified on GitHub main.
